value.title: Phase 1: heal + align + drain
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; each task names its evidence. Stop-and-ask o-prime on anything that reverses a ruling or leaves the fence.

value.title: Verify the FILL-alignment hypothesis and measure it: read tokens.rs (FILL, fit_to_cap) and chunk_plan in enrich.rs; state at ack whether chunk_plan applies FILL; print chunk counts on the fixture corpus with/without alignment and whether 20,872 chars would split
value.success: chunk_plan window honours FILL (or the ack states why not) and both counts are recorded
value.receipt: cargo test -p fs3-daemon chunk_plan -- --nocapture: 6 passed; ruled corpus 7→10, 33→50, 1→2, total 41→62

value.title: Classify the cap rejection as a distinct error in crates/providers/src/{openai,azure_openai}.rs; other 400s unchanged
value.success: both adapters map the 8192-cap 400 to one variant; tests on both
value.receipt: cargo test -p fs3-providers cap_rejection: 4 passed; OpenAI and Azure typed cap 400 plus unrelated-400 controls

value.title: Re-split on rejection, bounded: in the f-001 sub-batch loop, catch the variant, isolate the item (input[N] from the body, else bisect), re-plan tighter, re-issue; MAX_HEAL_ROUNDS constant; exhaustion = one named failure + jobs.terminal
value.success: mutation-checked heal test + exhaustion test green; no duplicate chunk rows
value.receipt: cap_rejection_ tests: 3 passed; oversize suite: 12 passed; mutation with typed heal arm removed: same heal test failed 0/1, restored then passed; exhaustion asserted hash/20872 bytes/final 1 byte-token ratio/terminal=true and boot sweep=0

value.title: Gate and PR: harness checks green in the worktree; fix: commits via harness commit; PR into main with the mutation and the two measurements in the body
value.receipt: harness checks status=ok; PR https://github.com/AI-Substrate/flowspace3/pull/92; GitHub gate passed in 5m14s on head 24e67b881eed5804eb9efd4d59d535ebcd0dbf36

value.title: Prod drain with o-prime: hand over the before-status envelope and the five dedupe keys + the exact re-queue mechanism; after o-prime's bounce read back status, key states, and one real search over the recovered conversation; write receipts into ac-0005/0006
value.success: five keys done or terminal-with-reason; search hit in the recovered conversation
value.receipt: AC-0005 passed: after bounce four jobs done attempts=1; duplicate 1316706 terminal duplicate-of:1323215; status embed failed=1 named residue. AC-0006 amended after conv:recovery premise was disproven; document search returned exact score-1 hit el:git:github.com/AI-Substrate/pij/docs/plans/112-verb-usage/report.md::pij verb usage ranking for recovered hash c74f7075.

tk-0101.assertion: fixture-corpus chunk counts before/after alignment printed by a test, and the 20,872-char answer stated

tk-0102.assertion: tests prove the cap 400 maps to the variant and a different 400 does not, on both adapters

tk-0103.assertion: heal test green; same test red with the heal arm removed (mutation stated in PR)
exhaustion test asserts item/bytes/ratio in the message and terminal=true

tk-0104.assertion: harness checks green locally and CI green on the PR head sha
